import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt

raw = Path('results/expansion/raw/dice/nvidia_nemotron-3.5-bolt-e4b.jsonl')
protocol = Path('results/expansion/protocol-bolt-resume.json')
entry = json.loads(protocol.read_text())['nvidia/nemotron-3.5-bolt-e4b']['dice']
data = raw.read_bytes()
rows = [json.loads(line) for line in data.splitlines()]
prefix = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:' + str(raw)])
assert len(rows) == 138 and sorted(r['seed'] for r in rows) == list(range(200, 338))
assert all(r['game'] == 'dice' and len(r['rounds']) == 6 for r in rows)
assert data.startswith(prefix)
assert entry['error'] == 'RuntimeError: NotFoundError(404): Error code: 404'
record = {'provenance': receipt({'purpose': 'retain the second Bolt dice transport failure without scoring the partial cohort'}, 'NIM immutable deployment revision not exposed'),
          'source': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'episodes_saved': len(rows),
          'seed_first': 200, 'seed_last': 337, 'evaluation_attempt': entry,
          'raw_file': str(raw), 'raw_sha256': file_sha256(raw),
          'prior_committed_prefix_preserved': True,
          'prior_committed_episode_count': prefix.count(b'\n'),
          'interpretation': 'Missing-only resume adds 43 complete dice episodes before another HTTP 404. Cards generation succeeds afterward in the same batch, so 404 is not sufficient evidence of permanent endpoint retirement. No partial-cohort score; successful responses and episodes remain fixed.'}
Path('results/expansion/bolt_resume_dice_failure.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({k: record[k] for k in ('episodes_saved', 'prior_committed_episode_count')}))
